lines.t: Good morning. Welcome to Bridge Language School. How can I help you?
Good morning. I would like to register for an English course, please.
Certainly. Have you studied English before?
Yes, I studied it at school for six years, but I haven't practised much since then. I think my level is intermediate.
We will check that with a short test. We have two types of course.
The evening course meets three times a week, and the intensive course meets every morning.
I work in the afternoons, so the intensive course would suit me better. When does it start?
The next one starts on the third of October and lasts ten weeks. Each lesson is two and a half hours.
How much does it cost?
It is five hundred and eighty pounds, and that includes the books. If you register this week, you get ten percent off.
That sounds good. What do I need to do now?
Please fill in this form and bring a passport photo tomorrow. The placement test is on Friday at nine thirty, in room fourteen.
Can I pay in two parts?
Yes. You can pay half now and half in the first week of the course.
Perfect. Thank you for your help.

qs.q: Why does the student choose the intensive course?
qs.why: قال إنه يعمل بعد الظهر فتناسبه الدورة الصباحية.

qs.q: How often does the evening course meet?
The next course starts on the ___ of October.
qs.why: تبدأ الدورة في الثالث من أكتوبر.

qs.q: The course costs ___ pounds.
The price includes the books.
When is the placement test?
qs.why: الاختبار يوم الجمعة الساعة التاسعة والنصف.

qs.q: He must pay the full price today.
qs.why: يمكنه دفع النصف الآن والنصف لاحقاً.

title: A job interview for a part-time job

lines.t: Thank you for coming in, Layla. Please sit down. Can you tell me a little about yourself?
Of course. I am a second-year student, and I study business. I am looking for a part-time job because I want some experience and a little extra money.
Why do you want to work in our bookshop?
I love reading, and I enjoy talking to people. Last summer, I worked in a clothes shop, so I know how to help customers.
That is useful. What was the hardest part of that job?
Probably the busy weekends. There were long lines, but I learned to stay calm and work quickly.
Good. We need someone for twelve hours a week. Could you work on Saturdays?
Yes, I could work all day Saturday. I have classes from Monday to Thursday, but I am free on Friday afternoon, too.
Excellent. The pay is eleven dollars an hour. You would start with a one-week training period.
That sounds fine. Will I work with a team?
Yes. There are four of us, and we all share the tasks. If you are successful, I will call you by Wednesday.
Thank you. I look forward to hearing from you.

qs.q: What does Layla study?
Where did she work last summer?
She found quiet days the hardest part of her last job.
qs.why: الأصعب كان عطلات نهاية الأسبوع المزدحمة.

qs.q: The job is for ___ hours a week.
When is she free besides Saturday?
qs.why: قالت إنها متفرغة بعد ظهر الجمعة.

qs.q: The pay is ___ dollars an hour.
The manager will call by ___.
qs.why: قال: I will call you by Wednesday.

title: A radio item about a new city park

lines.t: Good morning, and welcome to City Radio. Our top story today is the opening of Riverside Park, the biggest new green space in our city for thirty years.
The park opens this Saturday at ten o'clock. It covers about twenty hectares along the river, in a place where an old factory stood until 2015.
The city council spent four years planning the project.
It planted more than two thousand trees, and it built a lake, three playgrounds and a ten-kilometre path for cyclists and walkers.
There is also a small cafe, which is run by local students, and a library of outdoor books for children.
The council says that the park will reduce traffic noise and make the air cleaner in nearby streets.
Entry is free, but cars are not allowed inside.
Visitors can leave their cars at the car park on Mill Road, which costs two pounds for the whole day. Bicycles can be rented at the main gate.
On opening day, there will be music from eleven, and a free picnic for families at one o'clock.
Remember to bring a hat, because there is not much shade yet. The young trees will need a few years to grow.
That was the news. Now, here is the traffic.

qs.q: The park opens this ___.
What was on the land before the park?
qs.why: كان في المكان مصنع قديم حتى عام 2015.

qs.q: The council planted more than ___ trees.
Who runs the cafe?
Cars are allowed inside the park.
The car park costs ___ pounds for the day.
Why should visitors bring a hat?
o: The sun is very hot in winter
qs.why: الأشجار صغيرة ولا ظل كافياً بعد.

lines.t: Hi, Nadia. Shall we decide how to organise our presentation on renewable energy? We have only ten minutes.
Yes. I think we should start with a short introduction, and then talk about solar power and wind power.
Good idea. I can do the solar part, because I read a lot about it for my last essay. Can you take wind power?
Sure. But I would like to add a slide about costs, because many people think that renewable energy is too expensive.
Right. Maybe we can show a simple graph. Do you know where we can find some reliable data?
The library has a report from the energy ministry. I borrowed it last week, and I can scan the main table.
Perfect. How many slides should we have?
About eight. If we have more, we will speak too quickly.
Agreed. Let's practise on Thursday afternoon. Professor Hall is free at four, so we could ask him for some feedback.
Good. I will send him an email tonight. Shall I also book a room with a projector?
Yes, please. And let's finish with a question for the audience. It makes people think.
Great. I will write one tomorrow.

qs.q: What is the presentation about?
The presentation lasts ___ minutes.
Who will talk about wind power?
What extra slide does Nadia want?
They plan to use about ___ slides.
They will practise on Thursday morning.
qs.why: سيتدربان بعد الظهر الساعة الرابعة يوم الخميس.

qs.q: How will they end the presentation?
o: With a question for the audience

lines.t: Lost property office. How can I help you?
Hello. I lost my bag on the train this afternoon, and I am very worried.
I am sorry to hear that. Can you describe it, please?
It is a black backpack, quite big, with a red label on the front. It also has a broken zip on the side pocket.
What was inside?
My laptop, a blue notebook, a pair of glasses and a bottle of water. Most importantly, my charger was in there.
Which train were you on?
The two forty-five from Chicago to Detroit. I sat in coach three, next to the window, and I got off at about five.
Okay. Let me write that down. What is your name and phone number?
Daniel Ross. That is R, O, S, S. My number is five five five, three two zero, seven seven one.
Thank you, Mr Ross. Is there anything valuable in the bag, like money or documents?
No money, thank goodness, but my university card is in the front pocket.
I will note that on the form. We will search the train tonight. If we find the bag, we will phone you tomorrow morning.
How long do you keep lost bags?
For thirty days. After that, we give them to charity.

qs.q: Where did the man lose his bag?
The label on the front is ___.
qs.why: قال: a red label on the front.

qs.q: What is wrong with the bag?
The train left at ___.
The man sat in coach five.
His surname is spelt R, O, S, S: ___.
qs.why: تهجئة الاسم R, O, S, S.

qs.q: How long does the office keep lost bags?

lines.t: Good afternoon, everyone. Today I would like to talk about sleep, and why it is so important for students.
Most adults need between seven and nine hours of sleep every night. When we sleep, our brain stores new information, and our body repairs itself.
If we do not sleep enough, we find it difficult to concentrate, and we feel more stressed.
So, what can we do to sleep better?
My first tip is to go to bed and get up at the same time every day, even at the weekend.
This helps the body to build a routine.
Second, avoid screens for at least one hour before bed. The light from phones and laptops tells the brain that it is still daytime.
Third, be careful with caffeine.
Coffee, tea and energy drinks can stay in the body for up to eight hours, so it is better not to drink them after three o'clock in the afternoon.
Finally, keep your bedroom cool, dark and quiet. A temperature of about eighteen degrees is ideal.
Many students believe that they can catch up on sleep at the weekend, but research shows that this does not work well. A regular routine is much better.
Thank you for listening.

qs.q: Most adults need seven to ___ hours of sleep.
qs.why: يحتاج البالغون من سبع إلى تسع ساعات.

qs.q: What does the brain do during sleep?
What is the first tip?
o: Sleep at the same times every day
qs.why: أول نصيحة: نفس موعد النوم والاستيقاظ يومياً.

qs.q: Avoid screens for at least ___ hour before bed.
Caffeine can stay in the body for up to eight hours.
After what time should students avoid coffee?
Research shows that catching up on sleep at weekends works very well.
qs.why: قال إن هذا لا يعمل جيداً.
